findings.message: Method name "LibWP::__wp" is discouraged; PHP has reserved all method names with a double underscore prefix for future use. (method names starting with __ are only discouraged; nothing changes on newer PHP)

Global variable '$HTTP_RAW_POST_DATA' is deprecated since PHP 5.6 and removed since PHP 7.0; Use php://input instead (the variable is simply undefined on newer PHP (a notice, not a fatal error); some code sets it itself)
